# Book Publishing Cost

Book publishing cost guide: what it costs to publish, print and self-publish a book in the US and Nigeria, with independent 2026 pricing.

## Guides
- [Book Publishing Cost (Home)](https://bookpublishingcost.com/): cost ranges by format and what drives them
- [Editing Cost](https://bookpublishingcost.com/editing-cost): editing and proofreading pricing by word count
- [Cost to Print a Paperback Book](https://bookpublishingcost.com/cost-to-print-paperback-book): per-copy print economics
- [Cost to Publish a Novel](https://bookpublishingcost.com/cost-to-publish-a-novel): novel-specific costs
- [Book Printing Services](https://bookpublishingcost.com/book-printing-services): what print services include and charge
- [Self Publishing Companies](https://bookpublishingcost.com/self-publishing-companies): publisher models compared
- [Print a Book](https://bookpublishingcost.com/print-a-book): how to print a book start to finish
